items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: The interviewee mentions Frank Pena in the context of club ownership ('Frank Pena's club was Doudrop') and business dealings with other artists ('Frank came in... buying artists from him'), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Frank Pena himself.

ctx.x: No, Frank Pena's club was Doudrop.
